positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Researched 10+ open-source text editors and recommended Etherpad based on its real-time editing capabilities, active development, flexible licensing, and plugin ecosystem.
- Integrated Etherpad with Wrapsody eCo to develop a real-time collaborative workspace, enhancing idea sharing and team communication.
- Presented the final project to company board members, including the CEO of Fasoo, and analyzed its potential for commercial expansion within the Wrapsody eCo platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Enhanced the ART (Automatic Recognition Test) tool by generating 1,000 test scenarios, improving test coverage and automation.
- Conducted software testing for ICAS3 & MIB3 (Volkswagen Infotainment System Voice Control), validating each new release and reporting results to the project manager.

positions.title: Assistant to Vice Chief of Naval Operations / Navy Headquarters
positions.description:
- Provided protocol support for the Vice Chief of Naval Operations, managing VIP visits, official events, and ceremonial duties at Navy Headquarters.
- Delivered executive administrative assistance, including schedule management, document preparation, and logistical coordination for the Vice Chief.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant / ROKS Gyeongbuk (FF-956)
positions.description:
- Managed onboard personnel records and created duty rosters during both port and sailing operations.
- Issued leave documents and supported onboard administrative operations.
